name: Horsemen
caption: The Franchise stable led by Brick Wall, whose members held FWG's Heavyweight, Tag Team and Deathmatch titles across the year.

tenures.source: its License to Kill PPV of 5 August 2001 and its WrestleSeries PPV of 2 September 2001

name: Shadow's Stable
caption: Shadow's own stable, called the Devil's Advocates by WrestleSeries; its members interfered for the N.I.W.F. at License to Kill and attacked Stone in the WrestleSeries Junkyard match.

tenures.source: its License to Kill PPV of 5 August 2001 and its WrestleSeries PPV of 2 September 2001

name: Dark Ones
caption: Darkside's stable, which won FWG's Deathmatch title and recruited R2K's own brother the Slammer under cover of a fake feud.

tenures.source: its License to Kill PPV of 5 August 2001 and its WrestleSeries PPV of 2 September 2001

name: El Que Ha Estado Encarcelado
caption: A three-man lucha trio beaten by the Dark King, Black Ninja and Switch at License to Kill.

tenures.source: its License to Kill PPV of 5 August 2001

name: Total Carnage
caption: A stable including the FWG Television champion Sheyda, billed on FWG's cards through the fall of 2001.

identity.note: Shares only its name with an existing unit of the same name; no document links them.

tenures.source: its Tuesday Rampage card of 20 August 2001 and its WrestleSeries PPV of 2 September 2001
tenures.note: WrestleSeries and a 2 October 2001 card also bill a tag team "Total Carnage" of Crow and a wrestler named Spawn who is not otherwise served here; membership beyond Sheyda is not fully resolved.
